team.title: Team
team.description: Everyone who works on OneOhm projects: staff, I&C partner crews and resellers. Roles decide what each person can see and do.
team.search: Search by name, phone, email or ID
team.emptyBody: Try another name or clear the role filter.

form.emailHint: For signing in to the web app.
form.phoneHint: For signing in to the mobile app with a one-time code.
form.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. They can change it after signing in.
form.newPasswordHint: Leave blank to keep the current password. Setting one signs them out everywhere.
form.rolesHint: Choose at least one. A person can hold several roles.

addDialog.title: Add a person
addDialog.description: They can sign in as soon as you save. Give an email and password for the web, a mobile number for the app, or both.

editSheet.title: Edit person
editSheet.onLeaveHint: New tasks go to someone else in the same role while they are away.
editSheet.activeHint: Turning this off signs them out and keeps their history.
editSheet.skillsHint: Tasks that need a skill go first to people in the role who have it.

team.noAccess: You do not have permission to see the team.

decide.noteHint: Optional. They see it with your decision.

attendance.emptyBody: Staff appear here once they are added to the team.
attendance.caption: Attendance for the day

corrections.title: Corrections
corrections.description: People asked to fix a check-in or check-out time. Approving changes their day.

leave.intro: Leave is counted in working days; a half day counts as 0.5. Approving hands the open tasks in those days to the backup.
leave.handedOver: {count, plural, =0 {no tasks handed over} one {# task handed over} other {# tasks handed over}}

balances.label: Your leave balances
balances.left: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left of {allowed}
balances.waiting: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} waiting for approval

queue.title: Waiting for a decision
queue.description: Oldest first. Your own requests go to someone else.
queue.none: No leave requests waiting for you.
queue.handoverOnApprove: Approving hands their open tasks in these days to {name}.
queue.noHandover: No backup was named, so no tasks move.
queue.approvedHandover: {count, plural, =0 {No open tasks needed handing to {name}.} one {# task handed over to {name}.} other {# tasks handed over to {name}.}}

history.title: Everyone’s leave
history.description: Upcoming leave soonest first; past leave latest first.

mine.title: Your leave
mine.description: What is left this year, and your requests.
mine.none: You have not asked for leave yet.
mine.confirmBody: The days go back to your balance. If tasks were handed over, they stay with your backup until someone reassigns them.

impact.label: What this leave covers
impact.pickDays: Pick the days to see how many count, what is left after, and the work they touch.
impact.left: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} of {kind} left after this
impact.over: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} more than your {kind} left
impact.overlap: You already have leave on some of these days.
impact.noTasks: Nothing you own is due in these days.
impact.tasks: {count, plural, one {# task due while you are away} other {# tasks due while you are away}}

cover.title: Who covers your work
cover.description: Suggested from people with the same role, least busy first. You choose; nothing moves until the leave is approved.
cover.openTasks: {count, plural, =0 {No open tasks} one {# open task} other {# open tasks}}
cover.hintTasks: {count, plural, one {Approving hands this task to them.} other {Approving hands these # tasks to them.}}
cover.hintNoTasks: Nothing is due, but they will know to stand in.
cover.noteHint: Optional. Where things are, who to call.
cover.nobodyFree: Nobody who does this kind of work is free on these days. A manager can reassign the tasks after approving.

apply.title: Apply for leave
apply.description: Choose the days. You will see what they affect before you send it.
apply.toHint: Leave empty for a single day.
apply.emergencyHint: For days already gone or short notice. It can go over your balance.

points.intro: Points thank people for dependable work: tasks finished on time, good customer ratings and recognition from a manager. Rating points wait for a manager to agree.

standings.title: Standings
standings.description: Approved points only. This month first, then all time.
standings.emptyBody: Points appear here once work is recognised.

suggestions.title: Suggestions waiting
suggestions.description: Suggested after good customer ratings. Approve the ones that are fair.

recent.title: Recent points
recent.description: The latest decided points, newest first.

give.title: Give recognition
give.description: Thank someone for good work. They see the points and why.
give.reasonHint: A sentence they will be glad to read.

rules.title: What earns points
rules.onTimeDetail: Given automatically when a task is finished by its due date.
rules.ratingDetail: Suggested after a good rating; a manager approves it.
rules.recognitionDetail: Given by a manager, with a reason.

resellers.intro: Leads each reseller brought, how many turned into projects, the value sold and the commission they earned. Finance approves and pays commission under Finance, Commissions & rewards.
resellers.caption: Reseller performance
resellers.emptyBody: Add a person with the Reseller / Promoter role under People. Their leads and commission show here.
resellers.defaultHint: Every reseller without their own rule earns this.
resellers.projectsSold: {count, plural, =0 {No projects} one {# project} other {# projects}} · {size}

sheet.descriptionDefault: Applies to every reseller without their own rule. Commission already earned keeps its terms.
sheet.descriptionFor: This reseller's own rule, instead of the default. Commission already earned keeps its terms.
sheet.activeHint: When off, nothing new is earned.
sheet.rateHint: Of the full contract price the customer pays, for example 3.
sheet.perKwHint: For each kW of capacity sold.
sheet.eventHint: Commission is earned once, when the project reaches this step.

skills.none: No skills set up yet. Add them in Settings → Workforce.
